role.zh: 研究者 · 开源探索者

about.zh: 你好，欢迎来到我的个人主页。这里记录我的研究、项目与开源实践。
about.en: Hello, and welcome to my personal homepage. This is a home for my research, projects, and open-source work.

about.zh: 我关注大语言模型、检索增强生成与人机协同，希望探索更可靠、可解释的智能系统。
about.en: My interests include large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and human–AI collaboration, with a focus on reliable and interpretable intelligent systems.

about.zh: 我也喜欢把想法做成可用的工具，分享代码、实验与学习记录。欢迎就相关研究和开源项目交流合作。
about.en: I enjoy turning ideas into useful tools and sharing code, experiments, and learning notes. I welcome conversations about related research and open-source collaboration.

text.zh: 个人主页上线，持续记录研究与开源实践。
text.en: Launching this homepage to document research and open-source work.
